history.feedback:
- scene hook: score 5/10. Problems: Steering wheel model is an overly simple torus primitive with basic spokes; the 3D text 'NO AIR TANK' label looks amateurish and disrupts visual clarity.. Fix: Upgrade to a realistic modern steering wheel model with textured leather and trim, enhance the internal cutaway detail, and replace text label with clean motion graphics overlay.
- scene sensor: score 2/10. Problems: Completely abstract arrangement of a red block and a spring coil over a plain blue backdrop; fails to depict a MEMS sensor micro-mechanism or a crash dummy head.. Fix: Model a detailed cutaway of a MEMS micro-accelerometer with comb fingers alongside a crash scene element or dummy head moving rapidly forward.
- scene igniter: score 4/10. Problems: The internal element resembles a cartoon bomb shape rather than an electrical squib wire and solid chemical pellets; lighting is flat.. Fix: Replace central shape with realistic stacked solid chemical propellant pellets and a fine glowing electrical filament wire initiating combustion.
- scene nitrogen: score 4/10. Problems: Shows a generic grey cylinder under a metal shroud with no visible gas build-up, escaping volumetric smoke/gas, or perforated mesh screen.. Fix: Add detailed perforated mesh surrounding the canister and render volumetric hot nitrogen gas escaping rapidly through the holes under high pressure.
- scene bag_and_vents: score 1/10. Problems: The image is entirely overexposed white glowing spheres against a light background; completely unrecognisable as an airbag, with zero visible fabric, vents, or mounting hardware.. Fix: Fix lighting exposure, apply realistic woven nylon fabric material with seams, and show active gas jetting out from rear deflation vent ports.
- scene summary: score 4/10. Problems: Exploded view uses basic primitive stacked disks and rings rather than actual detailed inflator components; text tag 'SUB-30ms INFLATION' adds clutter.. Fix: Render an accurate exploded CAD assembly showing distinct, detailed layers (housing, filter mesh, pellet disk, squib, folded fabric) aligning into the steering wheel.

- scene summary: score 4/10. Problems: Shows a simple stack of basic shapes rather than a detailed CAD exploded view.. Fix: Separate and label realistic CAD assembly components vertically.
